title: Luau & Roblox Studio Mastery Reference
summary: Comprehensive knowledge base covering: (1) Luau language syntax, type system, standard library, linter rules, compatibility with Lua 5.x; (2) Roblox official style guide and best practices; (3) Complete Roblox Engine API reference organized by domain: Core Classes (Instance, Players, Humanoid, Services), Parts & Physics (BasePart, Model, Camera, Constraints, Terrain), GUI System (GuiObject, Layouts, ScreenGui, ProximityPrompt), Scripting & Communication (RemoteEvents, DataStores, UserInputService, TweenService), Effects & Media (Lighting, Particles, Sound, Materials), Game Services (Marketplace, Teleport, Pathfinding, Chat, Animation), and Data Types & Enums (CFrame, Vector3, Color3, UDim2, KeyCode, Material).
